title: ODNI interested in how Borland tracked search-and-rescue taskers
summary: Dylan Borland tells of ODNI interested in how Borland tracked search-and-rescue taskers, about 2023-2025 at ODNI / ICIG, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: know a search and rescue tasker with imagery and sigant when I see it and I know what is our guys and what isn't.

plain: Dylan Borland, a man who came forward with claims about unexplained craft, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that between about 2023 and 2025 officials from the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, the office that oversees US spy agencies, and its internal watchdog wanted to know how he had kept track of search-and-rescue assignments. Borland says he knows such an assignment when he sees one, backed by images and intercepted electronic signals, and he can tell which ones involve "our guys" and which do not. If true, it would suggest some of those missions were about recovering things that were not human-made.
